types.name: Checkpoint
docs: One checkpoint of the tick accumulator.
Layout note: `#[zero_copy]` derives `bytemuck::Pod`, which forbids implicit padding, and
`i128` is 16-byte aligned on the host. The semantic fields keep the SPEC order
(`ts`, `cum`); `padding` makes the layout explicit (32 bytes, `cum` at offset 16).

fields.name: liquidators
docs: Liquidator allowlist; `Pubkey::default()` marks an empty slot.

fields.name: liquidator_only
docs: Launch with liquidation permissioned (SPEC §2.7).

types.name: InsuranceWithdraw
docs: An insurance withdrawal waiting for its timelock.

types.name: Market
docs: The market. PDA `["market", abtc_mint, usdc_mint]`.

fields.name: vault_program
docs: `brrr_vault` program id.

fields.name: vault
docs: `brrr_vault` Vault account.

fields.name: vault_btc
docs: Token-2022 account whose amount is A (from the Vault).

fields.name: collateral_vault
docs: PDA `["collateral", market]`, SPL account of abtc, owner = authority.

fields.name: liquidity_vault
docs: PDA `["liquidity", market]`, SPL account of usdc, owner = authority.

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: `Pubkey::default()` = none.

fields.name: insurance_shares
docs: Supply shares owned by the market itself (reserve factor + `fund_insurance`).

fields.name: total_collateral
docs: Σ Position.collateral == collateral_vault.amount.

fields.name: pause_flags
docs: bit0 SUPPLY, bit1 WITHDRAW, bit2 DEPOSIT_COLLATERAL (retired, unsettable), bit3 WITHDRAW_COLLATERAL,
bit4 BORROW, bit5 LIQUIDATE.

fields.name: withdraw_pause_until
docs: WITHDRAW counts only while `now < this`.

fields.name: liquidate_pause_until
docs: LIQUIDATE counts only while `now < this`.

fields.name: deleverage
docs: bonus → `deleverage_bonus_bps`, close factor 100 %, no new borrows.

fields.name: frozen
docs: Set by `settle_bad_debt` beyond the socialisation limit; blocks everything except repay / liquidate / settle.

fields.name: liquidators
docs: Allowlist for `liquidate`; `Pubkey::default()` marks an empty slot. Four slots so the keeper
can be rotated without a window where nobody may liquidate.

fields.name: liquidator_only
docs: `true` = only a listed key may liquidate. Ignored while `frozen` or `deleverage`: a wind-down
must never depend on our keeper being up.

fields.name: quote_decimals
docs: Decimals of the reward asset (`Vault.wbtc_mint`), 6..=9, read from the pool's own decimals byte and required
to equal `Vault.quote_decimals`. The Pyth leg is quoted per whole token, so this is what turns it into a
price per raw unit (SPEC §0.3). Written by `init_market`, re-derived by `apply_oracle_source`.

fields.name: pool_reversed
docs: `true` = the coin is the pool's token_0, so the pool's tick is reward-per-coin and is negated where it is
read (`oracle::read_pool_tick`). Everywhere else a tick means raw coin per raw reward asset.

fields.name: oracle_kind
docs: `ORACLE_KIND_CLMM` (the pool's own `tick_current`) or `ORACLE_KIND_CPMM` (the tick of the pool's net
reserve ratio). Set from `Vault.pool_kind` by `init_market` and never changed: a market cannot migrate
between pool kinds, because the ring it would carry over was measured a different way.

fields.name: debt_is_numeraire
docs: The vault's reward asset IS this market's debt asset (`Vault.wbtc_mint == usdc_mint`), so one raw unit is
worth exactly one raw unit: no Pyth leg, no depeg, and the two feed ids must be zero (SPEC §2.4).

fields.name: fee_risk_insured
docs: The coin's transfer-fee authority was live when the market opened (`MINT_POLICY_FEE_AUTHORITY_LIVE` on a
promoted vault, SPEC §0.4). Route B: whoever can raise that fee can cut what a liquidator receives, so
the borrow book of such a market may never exceed its own insurance (`borrow`).

fields.name: reserved
docs: Was 512; the five fields above came off its front, so the account size did not change.

types.name: MarketStats
docs: Lifetime counters.

fields.name: self_closes
docs: Positions closed by their own owner (SPEC §2.12).

fields.name: to_treasury_abtc
docs: aBTC taken as the protocol's share of the liquidation bonus. The ledger the later
insurance-fund / holder split reads; nothing spends it yet.

types.name: OracleCheckpoint
docs: Both ticks are raw coin per raw reward asset: on a market with `pool_reversed` they are the NEGATION of the
pool's own `tick_current` (SPEC §0.3), so an indexer can feed them to `price_from_tick` without knowing which
way round the pool is.

types.name: OracleConfig
docs: Oracle parameters (SPEC §2.1 `OracleConfig`).

fields.name: haircut_bps
docs: Redemption haircut applied to the aBTC price. Default 300 (× 0.97).

fields.name: twap_long_secs
docs: Borrow-side TWAP window. Default 1800.

fields.name: twap_short_secs
docs: Liquidation-side TWAP window. Default 600.

fields.name: confirm_secs
docs: SPEC §2.4. The median must span at least this long: the confirmation window, and the whole
manipulation defence now that the 30-minute floor is gone. Default 5, hard 3..30.

fields.name: median_samples
docs: How many fast observations the median looks at. Default 7, hard 3..15.

fields.name: min_median_samples
docs: Fewer usable observations than this and the market has not traded, so it has not crashed.
Default 3, hard 3..median_samples.

fields.name: seize_twap_secs
docs: Window for the realisable cap on `p_seize`. Default 60, hard 15..600.

fields.name: ema_cap_bps
docs: `p_borrow ≤ ema_cap_bps × ema / 10_000`. Default 15000.

fields.name: ema_period_secs
docs: EMA period of the tick. Default 86400.

fields.name: cp_max_age_borrow_secs
docs: Oldest checkpoint accepted by borrow / withdraw_collateral. Default 900.

fields.name: cp_max_age_liq_secs
docs: Oldest checkpoint accepted by liquidate. Default 7200.

fields.name: pyth_max_age_user_secs
docs: Pyth max age for user actions. Default 60.

fields.name: pyth_max_age_liq_secs
docs: Pyth max age for liquidations. Default 600.

fields.name: pyth_max_conf_bps
docs: `conf / price ≤ this`. Default 100.

fields.name: depeg_bps
docs: `|wbtc − btc| / btc ≤ this` for borrows. Default 300.

fields.name: breaker_move_bps
docs: Breaker: twap_long move per hour. Default 2500.

fields.name: breaker_dev_bps
docs: Breaker: `|spot / twap_long − 1|`. Default 1500.

fields.name: breaker_resume_bps
docs: Breaker resumes after `breaker_resume_secs` below this deviation. Default 1000.

fields.name: breaker_resume_secs
docs: Default 600.

types.name: OracleSourceApplied
docs: `tick` is the first checkpoint of the new pool — oriented like every tick here, so negated when the new pool
is reversed (SPEC §0.3); every TWAP window is short until the ring refills.

types.name: OracleSourceProposed
docs: SPEC §2.11.

types.name: OracleState
docs: Tick accumulator, EMA and breaker (SPEC §2.1 `OracleState`). PDA `["oracle", market]`.
Layout note: fields keep the SPEC order; `breaker_tripped` is a `u8` (0/1) because `bool` is
not `Pod`, and the two explicit `padding*` arrays keep every `i128`/`u128` at a 16-byte offset
so the struct has no implicit padding on any target. Offsets (after the 8-byte discriminator):
market 0, idx 32, count 34, last_tick 36, last_ts 40, cum_last 48, ema_tick_x32 64, ema_ts 72,
breaker_tripped 80, breaker_tripped_at 88, breaker_calm_since 96, last_rate_wad 112, fast_idx 128,
fast_count 130, last_slow_ts 136, ring 144, fast 4240.
Two rings, because two prices move at two speeds (SPEC §2.4). `ring` is written at most every
`SLOW_SPACING_SECS` and its 128 slots span more than two hours, which is what `twap_long`, the EMA and
the breaker need. `fast` is written on every checkpoint — as often as once a second — and its 64 slots
carry the median that decides liquidations. One ring cannot do both: at a one-second cadence 128 slots
hold barely two minutes, and at a one-minute cadence a median is not a confirmation of anything.

fields.name: idx
docs: Newest checkpoint slot.

fields.name: count
docs: Number of valid ring entries (≤ 128).

fields.name: last_tick
docs: Tick recorded at the last checkpoint (accrues until the next one).

fields.name: cum_last
docs: tick_cumulative at `last_ts`.

fields.name: ema_tick_x32
docs: EMA of the tick, fixed point << 32.

fields.name: breaker_calm_since
docs: 0 = not calm.

fields.name: last_rate_wad
docs: Vault exchange rate; must be monotone.

fields.name: fast_idx
docs: Newest fast-ring slot.

fields.name: fast_count
docs: Valid fast-ring entries (≤ FAST_RING).

fields.name: last_slow_ts
docs: When the slow ring was last written.

types.name: PendingConfig
docs: A config waiting for its timelock.

types.name: PendingOracleSource
docs: A pool / feed change waiting for its timelock (SPEC §2.11).

types.name: PendingPool
docs: A pool change waiting for its timelock.

types.name: PendingRisk
docs: A risk config waiting for its timelock.

types.name: Position
docs: A borrower. PDA `["position", market, owner]`.

fields.name: collateral
docs: aBTC raw.

fields.name: last_ts
docs: Last interaction.

types.name: RiskConfig
docs: Risk parameters (SPEC §2.1 `RiskConfig`).

fields.name: ltv_bps
docs: Default 2000; hard 1000..2000 and `ltv < lt`. A max-LTV position is liquidated after a
`1 − ltv/lt` = 42.9 % fall. The coin has printed larger falls than that; see SPEC §2.1.

fields.name: lt_bps
docs: Default 3000; hard 3000..5000.

fields.name: liq_bonus_bps
docs: Top of the ramp. Default 2500; hard ≤ 2500.

fields.name: liq_bonus_base_bps
docs: Bottom of the ramp: what a liquidation costs the borrower at `HF = 1.00`. Default 1000, hard ≤ liq_bonus_bps.
Acting early is low-risk and should be cheap; acting late carries inventory risk and should pay for it.

fields.name: liq_bonus_ramp_wad
docs: Health span the ramp travels over: base at `HF = 1`, max at `HF = 1 − this`. Default 0.25 × WAD.

fields.name: dev_max_bps
docs: SPEC §2.7. When `|p_trigger / twap_5m − 1|` exceeds this, close only enough to restore health instead
of closing the position. 10000 disables it, which is the launch setting. Hard 2000..10000.

fields.name: protocol_bonus_bps
docs: Default 500, part of `liq_bonus_bps`; hard ≤ `liq_bonus_bps`.

fields.name: deleverage_bonus_bps
docs: Default 2000; hard ≤ 2500.

fields.name: self_close_bonus_bps
docs: Default 500; hard ≤ `liq_bonus_bps`. What a borrower pays to close their own position (SPEC §2.12).
It is cost recovery for the closer's unwind (≈ 450 bps), not profit — the treasury takes none of it.

fields.name: full_close_hf_wad
docs: Default 0.9 × WAD.

fields.name: min_debt
docs: Default 10 × 10^6. It was 20: a $100 deposit is $94 of collateral after the coin's fee and the haircut and
borrows at most $18.80 at a 20 % LTV, so the old floor shut the smallest depositor out entirely (SPEC §0.3).

fields.name: max_util_bps
docs: Default 9000 for new borrows; hard ≤ 9500.

fields.name: irm_base_bps
docs: Default 0.

fields.name: irm_slope1_bps
docs: Default 1000.

fields.name: irm_slope2_bps
docs: Default 10000.

fields.name: irm_kink_bps
docs: Default 8000; hard 0 < kink < 10000.

fields.name: reserve_factor_bps
docs: Default 1000; hard ≤ 5000.

fields.name: socialise_max_bps
docs: Default 1000 per settle event.

types.name: SelfClosed
docs: SPEC §2.12. No `to_treasury`: the whole bonus is the closer's cost recovery.

types.name: SupplyPosition
docs: A supplier. PDA `["supply", market, owner]`.

types.name: Vault
docs: The vault. PDA `["vault", btc_mint]`.

fields.name: btc_mint
docs: Token-2022 mint of the base coin.

fields.name: wbtc_mint
docs: SPL mint of the reward asset.

fields.name: abtc_mint
docs: PDA `["abtc", vault]`; SPL Token, 9 dec, mint authority = authority, no freeze authority.

fields.name: vault_btc
docs: `ATA(btc_multisig, btc_mint)` under Token-2022: owner = `btc_multisig`, delegate = authority for
`u64::MAX`. `amount` == total assets A. Owned by an on-curve address so the reward payer counts it
(`docs/v2/reward-delegate-design.html`).

fields.name: vault_wbtc
docs: `ATA(btc_multisig, wbtc_mint)` under SPL Token: owner = `btc_multisig`, delegate = authority for
`u64::MAX`. Must be the associated token account of the coin account's owner (stonkfun pays there).

fields.name: dead_shares
docs: PDA `["dead", vault]`; SPL token account of abtc, owner = authority; never debited.

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: `Pubkey::default()` = none.

fields.name: treasury_wbtc
docs: SPL token account (WBTC) that receives the performance fee.

fields.name: pool_vault_wbtc
docs: CLMM token_0 vault (input side of the harvest).

fields.name: pool_vault_btc
docs: CLMM token_1 vault (output side).

fields.name: sweep_eta
docs: 0 = none.

fields.name: pause_flags
docs: bit 0 DEPOSIT, bit 1 HARVEST, bit 2 REDEEM, bit 3 EXIT.

fields.name: redeem_pause_until
docs: REDEEM only counts while `now < redeem_pause_until`. Never zeroed after the first pause: it is also the
moment the last pause ended, from which `REDEEM_PAUSE_COOLOFF_SECS` runs.

fields.name: total_wbtc_harvested
docs: WBTC swapped (net of fee).

fields.name: exit_authority
docs: May call `redeem_swap` while `exit_open` is false. `Pubkey::default()` = none.

fields.name: exit_open
docs: `true` = `redeem_swap` is permissionless.

fields.name: total_btc_sold
docs: BTC sent to the pool by `redeem_swap` (gross, before the mint's transfer fee).

fields.name: total_wbtc_out
docs: WBTC delivered to exiters.

fields.name: btc_multisig
docs: 1-of-1 Token-2022 multisig whose sole signer is `authority`; owner of `vault_btc` and
`vault_wbtc`. Validated at `initialize` (`multisig::validate_multisig`); never changes.

fields.name: coin_decimals
docs: Decimals of `btc_mint` (6..=9); `abtc_mint` has the same.

fields.name: quote_decimals
docs: Decimals of `wbtc_mint` (6..=9), read from the mint at `initialize`.

fields.name: coin_is_token0
docs: Pool orientation: `false` = the reward asset is the pool's token_0, `true` = the coin is.

fields.name: pool_kind
docs: `POOL_KIND_CLMM` or `POOL_KIND_CPMM`.

fields.name: mint_policy
docs: `MINT_POLICY_*` bits recorded at `initialize`. Non-zero = never collateral (`brrr_lend::init_market`).

fields.name: quote_token_2022
docs: `wbtc_mint` is owned by Token-2022 rather than SPL Token.

fields.name: collateral_promoted
docs: SPEC §0.4: the admin decided, under timelock, that these shares may back a `brrr_lend` market although
`mint_policy` is not zero. Never written by `initialize*`; carved out of `reserved`, so every vault
created before this revision reads `false`.

fields.name: promotion_eta
docs: ETA of a pending promotion, and whether one is armed (`propose_collateral_promotion`).

types.name: VaultConfig
docs: Tunable parameters (SPEC §1.1 `VaultConfig`).

fields.name: perf_fee_bps
docs: Share of harvested WBTC sent to the treasury. Default 1000, hard max 3000.

fields.name: slippage_bps
docs: Allowed price move below the reference on top of the pool fee. Default 100, hard max 500.

fields.name: harvest_cooldown_secs
docs: Minimum seconds between harvests. Default 120, hard min 60.

fields.name: min_harvest_wbtc
docs: Harvest only when at least this much WBTC is waiting. Default 6_500 — about $5 at WBTC
$76.7k (2026-09-13). It is a RAW floor, so it drifts with the BTC price; the keeper enforces
the exact $5 off chain from the Pyth price it already reads and alerts when this drifts far
from it. On chain it is the backstop that stops a dust harvest burning the 1 % pool fee and
resetting the cooldown.

fields.name: max_harvest_wbtc
docs: Largest single harvest. Default 2_000_000.

fields.name: max_harvest_pool_bps
docs: `amount_in ≤ pool_vault_wbtc.amount × this / 10_000`. Default 50, hard max 200.

fields.name: min_deposit
docs: Smallest deposit (in raw BTC units). Default 10^9.

fields.name: deposit_cap
docs: Total assets after a deposit may not exceed it. Default 50_000_000 × 10^9.

fields.name: max_transfer_fee_bps
docs: Deposits revert when the mint's live transfer fee exceeds it. Default 500.

fields.name: twap_window_secs
docs: TWAP window for the harvest reference tick. Default 600, hard range 60..3600.

fields.name: twap_max_age_secs
docs: Older observation ring → fall back to `pool_state.tick_current`. Default 1800.

fields.name: max_exit_pool_bps
docs: `redeem_swap`'s BTC ≤ `pool_vault_btc.amount × this / 10_000`. Default 200, hard max 500.
Larger than `max_harvest_pool_bps` on purpose: a harvest is a drip, an exit clears a liquidation.

fields.name: min_exit_shares
docs: Dust floor for `redeem_swap`. Default 10^9 (1 aBTC).
